note: Curated half of the parameter catalog (docs/parameters.md, Parameter catalog). Edit the words and ranges here; objects' modes, sizes and per-size defaults come from the engine. Rebuild spec/parameters.json with PARAMS_CATALOG_WRITE=1 cargo test -p core_engine --test parameter_catalog -- --ignored.

patterns.label: Working
patterns.description: Busy on a task: particles circle on tilted orbits while the agent works.

patterns.label: Searching
patterns.description: Looking something up: a scan line sweeps across a globe of dots.

patterns.label: Solving
patterns.description: Reasoning through a problem: bands twist like a puzzle cube, then settle.

patterns.label: Listening
patterns.description: The agent is listening: a wave rolls through rings while the user talks.

patterns.label: Connecting
patterns.description: Joining a session or linking ideas: a constellation wires itself together.

patterns.label: Weaving
patterns.description: Combining sources: three strands braid around the sphere.

patterns.label: Composing
patterns.description: Writing a reply: a ribbon of dots flows around the sphere.

patterns.label: Breathing
patterns.description: Idle and ready: a calm ring that slowly breathes.

patterns.label: Shaping
patterns.description: Reshaping or formatting: an outline morphs from circle to triangle to square.

patterns.label: Glowing
patterns.description: An ambient presence: a colored nebula drifting on a sphere.

patterns.label: Drifting
patterns.description: A looser constellation: its nodes wander on a smooth noise field.

patterns.label: Speaking
patterns.description: The agent is speaking: circular EQ bars pulse while it talks.

patterns.label: Confirming
patterns.description: Done or received: a ping ring expands and fades.

patterns.label: Initializing
patterns.description: Starting a session: a starfield streams outward from the center.

patterns.label: Calibrating
patterns.description: Tuning in: a standing-wave pattern snaps into new resonances.

patterns.label: Progressing
patterns.description: Progress on a sphere: a day and night line sweeps left to right as the app sets progress (0 to 1).

patterns.label: Muted
patterns.description: Mic muted or connection lost: a still, dimmed sphere.

patterns.label: Veil
patterns.description: A sheet of light with depth: layers of glowing points curl one behind the other. It swells with a voice or any 0 to 1 value and keeps moving on its own while something is being worked on.

patterns.label: Crystal
patterns.description: A crystal of light filled from below: each column lights up to its value and the unlit cells stay as dust. A voice's bands, a battery, a quota or a goal.

patterns.label: Dune
patterns.description: A dune of light: a recording's loudness (or any series) is its profile, the done part glows and a plane of light marks the position. A voice message or a long task's progress.

patterns.label: Comet
patterns.description: A stream of light orbiting a faint core, its tail breathing with the noise. Waiting with no end in sight: it burns brighter with a voice or any 0 to 1 value, longer while work goes on.

patterns.label: Flow
patterns.description: A front of light sweeping through a slab of points, a fainter one trailing it. Something is being made: it lights with a voice or any 0 to 1 value and shimmers while work goes on.

patterns.label: Cohesion
patterns.description: A sphere of light held together by quality: as it falls the points let go one by one, drift apart and warm to amber; as it recovers they gather back. A connection, a sync, a signal.

patterns.label: Scan
patterns.description: A tilted disc of light and a beam sweeping it: the beam lights what it passes and found points flash white and burn down. Looking for something.

colorHue@shared.label: Hue
colorHue@shared.description: Hue of the picked colour (FX Spec accepts a hex value instead).

colorLightness@shared.label: Lightness
colorLightness@shared.description: Lightness bias: below 0 darker, above 0 lighter; 0 keeps the pattern's own shading.

colorMix@shared.label: Colour mix
colorMix@shared.description: How far every element moves to the picked colour.

colorMode@shared.label: Colour mode
colorMode@shared.description: Ink mirrors lightness on dark themes; fixed keeps the exact colour in both.

dim@hush.label: Dim
dim@hush.description: How far the orb fades toward the paper.

dimBase@globe.label: Unscanned dots
dimBase@globe.description: Brightness of the dots the scan hasn't reached.

echoSpacing@sonar.label: Echo spacing
echoSpacing@sonar.description: Gap between echo rings, as a fraction of the cycle.

faceOn@ribbon.label: Face-on
faceOn@ribbon.description: Show the ribbon face-on instead of tilted.

faceOn@ring.label: Face-on
faceOn@ring.description: Show the ribbon face-on instead of tilted.

ghostA@orbits.label: Orbit paths
ghostA@orbits.description: Opacity of the faint orbit paths behind the particles.

ghostN@braid.label: Path dots
ghostN@braid.description: Dots along the faint guide strands.

ghostN@ribbon.label: Path dots
ghostN@ribbon.description: Dots in the faint guide ring.

ghostN@ring.label: Path dots
ghostN@ring.description: Dots in the faint guide ring.

ghostR@orbits.label: Path dot size
ghostR@orbits.description: Radius of the faint orbit-path dots.

glowBlend@shared.label: Blend
glowBlend@shared.description: Normal or additive halos (additive is a dark-theme look).

glowMode@shared.label: Mode
glowMode@shared.description: Stacked translucent copies, or one Gaussian-blurred halo per element.

glowRadius@shared.label: Radius
glowRadius@shared.description: Halo size as a multiple of the element.

glowStrength@shared.label: Glow
glowStrength@shared.description: Amount of glow; 0 turns the material off.

glowTint@shared.label: Tint
glowTint@shared.description: How far the halo moves toward the tint hue (0 = the element's own colour).

gradientAngle@shared.label: Angle
gradientAngle@shared.description: Direction of the ramp, CSS-style (0 = up, clockwise).

gradientHue2@shared.label: End hue
gradientHue2@shared.description: Hue at the end (or middle, with a third stop) of the ramp.

gradientHue3@shared.label: Third hue
gradientHue3@shared.description: Optional third stop's hue; absent = a two-stop ramp.

gradientHue@shared.label: Start hue
gradientHue@shared.description: Hue at the start of the ramp.

gradientMid@shared.label: Middle stop
gradientMid@shared.description: Position of the middle stop along the ramp (three stops).

gradientStrength@shared.label: Gradient
gradientStrength@shared.description: Amount of the colour ramp; 0 turns it off.

holdDuration@chladni.label: Hold time
holdDuration@chladni.description: Seconds each pattern holds before the next.

hue@hush.label: Tint hue
hue@hush.description: Hue of the muted warning tint.

hue@spectrum.label: Hue
hue@spectrum.description: Ink hue in degrees; applies once saturation is above 0.

hueOffset@aurora.label: Hue offset
hueOffset@aurora.description: Starting hue of the aurora colours.

hueSpeed@aurora.label: Hue cycle speed
hueSpeed@aurora.description: Degrees per second the colours cycle.

depthTone@aurora.label: Depth shading
depthTone@aurora.description: Tone difference between front and back dots (0 = one tone).

hueSpread@aurora.label: Hue spread
hueSpread@aurora.description: Range of hues across the sphere.

iconD@morph.label: Icon density
iconD@morph.description: Dot density of the morphing icon outlines.

ink@shared.label: Ink
ink@shared.description: How present the whole visual is: 1 draws it as the pattern defines it, lower fades everything including its halos. A voice assistant rests below 1 when idle and comes to full ink when it listens.

inkFar@globe.label: Far ink
inkFar@globe.description: Ink value of the far side (0 = darkest ink, 1 = paper).

inkFar@rubik.label: Far ink
inkFar@rubik.description: Ink value of the far side (0 = darkest ink, 1 = paper).

inkSpan@globe.label: Ink range
inkSpan@globe.description: How much darker the near side is than the far side.

inkSpan@rubik.label: Ink range
inkSpan@rubik.description: How much darker the near side is than the far side.

jumpSpeed@spectrum.label: Jump rate
jumpSpeed@spectrum.description: How fast the synthetic bars jump when no audio is supplied.

lanes@ribbon.label: Lanes
lanes@ribbon.description: Parallel lanes of dots in the ribbon.

lanes@ring.label: Lanes
lanes@ring.description: Parallel lanes of dots in the ribbon.

latRings@globe.label: Latitude rings
latRings@globe.description: Rings of dots from pole to pole.

latRings@rubik.label: Latitude rings
latRings@rubik.description: Rings of dots from pole to pole.

lonDensity@globe.label: Dot density
lonDensity@globe.description: Dots around the equator; other rings scale with their circumference.

lonDensity@rubik.label: Dot density
lonDensity@rubik.description: Dots around the equator; other rings scale with their circumference.

moveCount@rubik.label: Moves
moveCount@rubik.description: Layer turns in one solve cycle.

nodeRDepth@web.label: Node depth size
nodeRDepth@web.description: Extra node radius when nearest the viewer.

nodeRDepth@webflow.label: Node depth size
nodeRDepth@webflow.description: Extra node radius when nearest the viewer.

noiseAmplitude@shared.label: Amplitude
noiseAmplitude@shared.description: Jitter distance as a fraction of the frame.

noiseScale@shared.label: Scale
noiseScale@shared.description: Size of the noise field in cells across the frame.

noiseSpeed@shared.label: Speed
noiseSpeed@shared.description: How fast the noise field drifts (per second).

noiseStrength@shared.label: Noise
noiseStrength@shared.description: Amount of organic jitter; 0 turns the material off.

orbitN@orbits.label: Orbits
orbitN@orbits.description: Number of orbit paths the particles travel on.

partRDepth@orbits.label: Particle depth size
partRDepth@orbits.description: Extra particle radius when nearest the viewer (depth cue).

progress@eclipse.label: Progress
progress@eclipse.description: How far the eclipse has advanced, 0 to 1.

pulseAmplitude@hush.label: Breathing
pulseAmplitude@hush.description: Size of the slow breathing pulse.

pulseOpacity@shared.label: Opacity
pulseOpacity@shared.description: How much the pulse fades the frame at its low point.

pulsePhase@shared.label: Phase
pulsePhase@shared.description: Offset of the pulse cycle, in cycles.

pulseScale@shared.label: Scale
pulseScale@shared.description: How much the pulse shrinks the frame at its low point.

pulseStrength@shared.label: Pulse
pulseStrength@shared.description: Amount of the periodic pulse; 0 turns it off.

rActive@rubik.label: Active layer size
rActive@rubik.description: Extra dot radius on the layer that is turning.

rBoost@globe.label: Scan highlight
rBoost@globe.description: Extra dot radius inside the scanning band.

rDepth@braid.label: Depth size
rDepth@braid.description: Extra dot radius on the side facing the viewer.

rDepth@globe.label: Depth size
rDepth@globe.description: Extra dot radius on the side facing the viewer.

rDepth@ribbon.label: Depth size
rDepth@ribbon.description: Extra dot radius on the side facing the viewer.

rDepth@ring.label: Depth size
rDepth@ring.description: Extra dot radius on the side facing the viewer.

rDepth@rubik.label: Depth size
rDepth@rubik.description: Extra dot radius on the side facing the viewer.

rDepth@wave.label: Depth size
rDepth@wave.description: Extra dot radius on the side facing the viewer.

rDot@morph.label: Dot size
rDot@morph.description: Dot radius as a fraction of the frame.

rMin@shared.label: Minimum dot radius
rMin@shared.description: Dots are never drawn smaller than this, in engine units, so far-side dots stay visible at small sizes.

rings@wave.label: Rings
rings@wave.description: Rings of dots across the wave surface.

rsPow@shared.label: Radius scaling
rsPow@shared.description: How dot radii scale with the frame size: radius x (size / 64)^rsPow; lower keeps small sizes chunkier.

saturation@hush.label: Warning tint
saturation@hush.description: Strength of the muted warning tint (0 = grey).

saturation@spectrum.label: Saturation
saturation@spectrum.description: How far the ink moves from grey toward the hue (0 = the grey ink).

scanMul@globe.label: Scan speed
scanMul@globe.description: Speed of the scanning band across the globe.

signals@web.label: Signals
signals@web.description: Bright pulses travelling along the links.

signals@webflow.label: Signals
signals@webflow.description: Bright pulses travelling along the links.

spread@morph.label: Spread
spread@morph.description: Size of the shape relative to the frame.

spread@web.label: Spread
spread@web.description: Size of the network relative to the frame.

spread@webflow.label: Spread
spread@webflow.description: Size of the flowing network relative to the frame.

surfaceScale@aurora.label: Noise scale
surfaceScale@aurora.description: Scale of the flowing colour field on the sphere.

surfaceSpeed@aurora.label: Flow speed
surfaceSpeed@aurora.description: Speed of the colour field's flow.

thr@web.label: Link reach
thr@web.description: How close two nodes must be to link; higher links more pairs.

thr@webflow.label: Link reach
thr@webflow.description: How close two nodes must be to link; higher links more pairs.

turns@braid.label: Turns
turns@braid.description: How many times the strands twist around each other.

wobMul@ribbon.label: Wobble
wobMul@ribbon.description: How much the ribbon wobbles as it turns.

wobMul@ring.label: Wobble
wobMul@ring.description: How much the ribbon wobbles as it turns.

yaw@hush.label: Turn
yaw@hush.description: Slow turning speed of the sphere.

level@veil.label: Level
level@veil.description: How high the sheet swells, 0 to 1: any value (a bound input) or, when left out, a bound voice's level; with neither the sheet breathes on its own.

churn@veil.label: Churn
churn@veil.description: Restless work, 0 to 1: the sheet keeps moving with no level (thinking, processing).

layerCount@veil.label: Layers
layerCount@veil.description: Sheets of light, front to back.

level@crystal.label: Level
level@crystal.description: One value for the whole crystal, 0 to 1 (a battery, a quota, a goal). Left out, a bound voice's bands fill the columns; with neither it idles low.

churn@crystal.label: Churn
churn@crystal.description: Restless work, 0 to 1: cells light and fade on their own.

columnCount@crystal.label: Columns
columnCount@crystal.description: Columns of cells, one per band or value.

progress@dune.label: Progress
progress@dune.description: How much is done, 0 to 1: a clip's position or a long task's progress. The done part glows. Left out, the plane drifts across on its own.

churn@dune.label: Churn
churn@dune.description: Restless work, 0 to 1: the unlit sand shimmers.

envelope@dune.label: Envelope
envelope@dune.description: The dune's profile, 0 to 1 per value (a clip's loudness or any series; up to 64). Without it a fixed dune is drawn.

level@comet.label: Level
level@comet.description: How brightly and how long the stream burns, 0 to 1: any value (a bound input) or, when left out, a bound voice's level; with neither it glows low and keeps circling.

churn@comet.label: Churn
churn@comet.description: Restless work, 0 to 1: a longer, brighter tail (thinking, processing). Its pace is the view's speed.

level@flow.label: Level
level@flow.description: How strongly the fronts light the slab, 0 to 1: any value (a bound input) or, when left out, a bound voice's level; with neither it glows low and keeps sweeping.

churn@flow.label: Churn
churn@flow.description: Restless work, 0 to 1: a stronger second front and a shimmer across the slab (thinking, processing). Its pace is the view's speed.

level@cohesion.label: Level
level@cohesion.description: How brightly the sphere burns, 0 to 1: any value (a bound input) or, when left out, a bound voice's level; with neither it glows low.

churn@cohesion.label: Churn
churn@cohesion.description: Restless work, 0 to 1: a tremor through every point and a brighter sphere (trying again).

quality@cohesion.label: Quality
quality@cohesion.description: How whole the sphere is, 0 to 1: as it falls the points let go one by one and warm to amber; 1 (the default) is whole.

level@scan.label: Level
level@scan.description: How brightly the beam burns, 0 to 1: any value (a bound input) or, when left out, a bound voice's level; with neither it glows low.

churn@scan.label: Churn
churn@scan.description: Restless work, 0 to 1: a longer trail behind the beam (still searching). Its pace is the view's speed.

blips@scan.label: Found points
blips@scan.description: How many points the scan has found, 0 to 12: each flashes white as the beam reaches it and burns down.

materials.label: Glow
materials.description: Layered or blurred halos around every dot and stroke.

materials.label: Noise
materials.description: Organic jitter from a slow gradient-noise field.

materials.label: Pulse
materials.description: A periodic breathe of opacity and scale on any pattern.

materials.label: Gradient
materials.description: A colour ramp by position across the frame.

materials.label: Colour
materials.description: One brand colour for the whole frame.

runtimeInputs.label: Audio level
runtimeInputs.description: The live voice level 0 to 1; drives the radial breathing pulse on any pattern.

runtimeInputs.label: Audio strength
runtimeInputs.description: How strongly, and in which direction, the audio level moves the frame: positive swells it outward as the level rises (speaking), negative draws it inward (listening's inhale), 0 turns it off.

runtimeInputs.label: Audio bands
runtimeInputs.description: Per-band levels (from the voice pipeline), e.g. the columns of crystal.

runtimeInputs.label: Voice state
runtimeInputs.description: The synthetic idle / listening / speaking pattern when no audio is supplied (the SDK sets it).

runtimeInputs.label: Pointer
runtimeInputs.description: Pointer / touch scatter (pointerX, pointerY, pointerRadius, pointerStrength). The web view feeds it with `pointer: true`; on iOS and Android, pass the keys as overrides for now.

runtimeInputs.label: Interrupt
runtimeInputs.description: The one-shot barge-in flash: seconds since the interrupt (+ duration, strength, tint, hue).

runtimeInputs.label: Decay
runtimeInputs.description: A one-shot fade after an event: seconds since it (+ duration, curve, scale).

runtimeInputs.label: Aspect
runtimeInputs.description: Width / height of the view's box, for a box-layout pattern (the pattern's `layout: "box"`); the view sets it. 1 = square.
